neighbours.label: The initial tokens of assay abbreviations HPLC and ELISA in laboratory descriptions.
fire: The laboratory measured caffeine by HPLC in the tea extract.
Purity was confirmed with HPLC before the vial was sealed.
The technician selected HPLC for separating the pigments.
The assay report lists HPLC as the analytical method.
Antibody levels were determined by ELISA in the serum samples.
The protocol uses ELISA to detect the viral protein.
Each specimen underwent ELISA before the results were recorded.
The laboratory ordered an ELISA kit for the screening study.
quiet: The laboratory measured caffeine by high-performance liquid chromatography in the tea extract.
Purity was confirmed with high-performance liquid chromatography before the vial was sealed.
The technician selected high-performance liquid chromatography for separating the pigments.
The assay report lists high-performance liquid chromatography as the analytical method.
Antibody levels were determined by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay in the serum samples.
The protocol uses enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay to detect the viral protein.
Each specimen underwent enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay before the results were recorded.
The laboratory ordered an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay kit for the screening study.

predictions: Fire sentences should outrank the matched near misses; assessed once by quick-8+8@2. Failure is retained without revision.
notes: Random 16-pole sweep. Labels derived from both-pole cards and top-32 peak-token counts. No band archive covers this neuron. Sentences authored by Codex; no Bonsai-generated sentences. Exploratory probes, when declared, used different sentences from this pre-registration. These are a reproducible-looking subset of otherwise mixed top examples; no claim that the pole represents assays generally.
